einzeiler: Investigating the massive gambling scandal surrounding baseball star Shohei Ohtani.
kurzfassung: ESPN reporters trace how a confidential federal tip linked baseball superstar Shohei Ohtani to an illegal sports betting ring run by Mathew Boyer in Southern California. The explosive allegation threatened Ohtani's historic career, his record-breaking $700 million contract, and Major League Baseball's clean image. Journalists navigated intense secrecy and industry warnings to uncover the origins of the unprecedented scandal.
stichpunkte: ESPN reporters received a sealed federal court document linking an illegal Southern California bookie to a major sports star.
The confidential tip pointed directly to baseball superstar Shohei Ohtani, launching a high-stakes journalistic investigation.
Reporters had to tread extremely carefully to avoid starting a damaging rumor loop within baseball clubhouses.
Experts explained that illegal bookies remain popular in states like California due to the advantages of credit betting and anonymity.
Major League Baseball enforces strict lifetime bans for betting on the sport, echoing historical scandals involving the Chicago White Sox and Pete Rose.
Ohtani maintained a famously guarded personal life, making any information outside the baseball diamond scarce.
A massive $700 million contract with the Los Angeles Dodgers and extensive global endorsements made Ohtani's reputation immensely valuable.

Betrayal listeners, we're excited to share a special ad-free preview of Episode One of this season of​ ESPN’s 30 for 30 Podcasts: The Betrayal of Shohei Ohtani.
